source_gaps: The exact global uniqueness proof for the logarithmic-cosine flip was not recovered. The scalar reduction and numerical candidate are reproduced, without claiming global zero count or a certified bifurcation.

The exact defining germ ODE and seventh and higher coefficients were not recovered. The six displayed decimal coefficients are treated as rational input for finite tests, not exact analytic identities.
The underlying hypergraph/tensor support and concentration definitions were not recovered, so no matrix multiplication exponent is proved.
Original fMRI/EEG datasets, complete objective and successful run logs were not recovered. Reported measurements are not recreated.

Truncated mentions of a theta term, nested radicals, Darboux polynomials and a full no-chaos/transcendence program do not supply complete defining formulas or proofs. They are not filled with invented historical mathematics.
excluded_nonmathematics: Business-model and financial-advice discussion without a separately specified mathematical question.
historical_completeness: Comprehensive for distinct meaningful recovered mathematical clusters. Retrieval is not a complete chat export; an unrecovered passage is not evidence that no mathematics existed.
verification_scope: Portable standard-library scripts check exact rational identities, finite ranks, combinatorial counts and selected numerical examples. They do not turn approximations into interval-certified global theorems.
references: Relevant primary papers, author notes, official DLMF and author textbooks checked by web retrieval; unrelated default references removed. Elementary complete proofs may have an empty external reference list.
